title: “Are we writing an advice column for Spock here?” Understanding Stereotypes in AI Advice for Autistic Users

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with interpersonal decision-making scenarios (asking for advice) under autism disclosure vs. non-disclosure conditions, measuring shifts in recommendations, and correlating these shifts with the models' responses to explicitly stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical traits. Supplemented by qualitative interviews with autistic users.
